title: centaurea scabiosa subsp. calcarea
intro: Centaurea scabiosa subsp. calcarea, commonly known as the chalk knapweed, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea scabiosa subsp. calcarea include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as pain relief, wound healing, and antimicrobial activities. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable herb in the treatment of various health conditions.
